title: Apply wave speed equation

hook.scenario: Bijli ki chamak pehle dikhti hai aur badal garajne ki aawaz baad mein aati hai kyunki sound ki speed light se kam hoti hai.
hook.question: Hum kisi sound wave ki speed kaise calculate kar sakte hain?

mental_model.intuition: Speed = Kadam ki lambai × 1 second mein kitne kadam. (Speed = Wavelength × Frequency).
mental_model.description: Agar aapko pata hai ki sound wave ka ek cycle kitna lamba hai (Wavelength) aur ek second mein kitne cycles bante hain (Frequency), toh dono ko multiply karne se total speed nikal aati hai.

explanation:
Wave speed ka equation ek fundamental formula hai jo sound, light, aur kisi bhi dusri wave par apply hota hai. Iska basic idea bahut simple hai: speed ka formula $v = d / t$ hota hai.

Ek complete wave cycle ke liye, distance covered $d$ hoti hai **Wavelength** ($\lambda$) aur usko poora karne ka time $t$ hota hai **Time Period** ($T$). Toh hum likh sakte hain ki speed $v = \lambda / T$.

Kyunki hum jaante hain ki frequency $\nu = 1 / T$, isliye hum $1 / T$ ki jagah $\nu$ likh sakte hain. Isse hamara main wave speed equation banta hai: $v = \lambda \times \nu$.

Is equation (Speed = Wavelength × Frequency) ka matlab hai ki agar kisi given medium mein sound ki speed constant hai (jaise air mein approx 340 m/s), toh wavelength aur frequency ek doosre ke inversely proportional hote hain. High frequency wali sound ki wavelength choti hogi, aur low frequency ki wavelength badi hogi.

key_points.title: Constant Speed in a Medium
key_points.detail: For a given medium under same conditions, the speed of sound remains nearly constant.

worked_example.problem: A sound wave has a frequency of 2 kHz and wavelength 35 cm. Find the speed of the wave.

steps.narration: Sabse pehle values ko unki SI units mein convert karenge. Frequency Hz mein aur wavelength meters mein.
Values put karke speed calculate karenge.

worked_example.problem: A submarine sends a sonar signal with a frequency of 50 kHz. If the speed of sound in seawater is 1500 m/s, what is the wavelength of the sonar wave?

steps.narration: Is baar speed aur frequency di hui hai, toh formula ko rearrange karenge wavelength ke liye.
Frequency ko Hz mein convert karke values daal kar solve karenge (50 kHz = 50000 Hz).

common_mistakes.title: Forgetting unit conversions
common_mistakes.explanation: Students formula lagane se pehle kHz ko Hz mein aur cm ko meters mein convert karna bhool jate hain.

recall_questions.q: What is the relationship between speed, wavelength, and frequency?
If frequency is doubled and speed remains constant, what happens to the wavelength?
What happens to the speed of sound if we change the frequency in the same medium?
recall_questions.answer: The speed remains constant; only the wavelength changes.

oa_questions.question: A sound wave has a frequency of 2 kHz and wave length 35 cm. How long will it take to travel 1.5 km?
oa_questions.answer: First find speed: v = 0.35 * 2000 = 700 m/s. Time = Distance / Speed = 1500 / 700 = 2.14 s.
oa_questions.approach: Use the wave speed equation to find velocity, then apply basic kinematic formula t = d/v.

oa_questions.question: Write the formula relating speed, wavelength, and frequency.
